name: Add 5 voltage-gated channels to t0065 soma; sweep densities; measure firing rate and DSI change
short_description: Insert one of {Nav1.6, NaP, NaR, Kv3, Kv4} on the deposited Poleg-Polsky cell soma at one of 3 densities (low/med/high), 5 seeds per (channel, density, direction). 16 conditions x 2 directions x 5 seeds = 160 FULL trials.
